description: Thermodynamic test of which direction AraM runs in vivo at measured cytoplasmic DHAP and NAD+/NADH
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
R=8.314e-3; T=310.15   # kJ/mol/K, 37 C
# Reaction: DHAP + NADH + H+ -> sn-glycerol-1-phosphate + NAD+
# No published dGo' for the G1P enantiomer; the enantiomeric reaction catalysed by
# sn-glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenase (GpsA) has dG'o about -21.9 kJ/mol (pH 7, I=0.1).
# Chirality does not change the standard free energy of the redox chemistry, so the
# same value is used, with a +/-5 kJ/mol sensitivity band.
dG0_list=[-16.9,-21.9,-26.9]
# cytoplasmic concentrations: E. coli, glucose minimal, Bennett et al. 2009 (PMID 19561621)
DHAP=0.37e-3; NADp=2.6e-3; NADH=8.3e-5
print("NAD+/NADH =", round(NADp/NADH,1))
rows=[]
for dG0 in dG0_list:
    Keq=np.exp(-dG0/(R*T))
    for ratio,label in [(NADp/NADH,"measured 31"),(100,"100"),(300,"300"),(1000,"1000")]:
        G1P_eq = DHAP*Keq/ratio            # [G1P] at which dG' = 0
        rows.append(dict(dG0_kJmol=dG0, NADplus_over_NADH=label, Keq=round(Keq,1),
                         G1P_at_equilibrium_mM=round(G1P_eq*1e3,2),
                         dG_at_G1P_0p1mM=round(dG0+R*T*np.log((1e-4*ratio)/DHAP),2)))
D=pd.DataFrame(rows); print(D.to_string(index=False)); D.to_csv("g1pdh_thermodynamics.csv",index=False)
print("\nTotal B. subtilis cytoplasmic metabolite pool is of order 100-300 mM; a single")
print("phosphomonoester at >50 mM is not physiological.")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7.5,4.4))
ratios=np.logspace(0.5,3.5,200)
for dG0,c in zip(dG0_list,["#9ecae1","#2f6f9f","#08306b"]):
    Keq=np.exp(-dG0/(R*T))
    ax.plot(ratios, DHAP*Keq/ratios*1e3, color=c, label=f"dG'o = {dG0} kJ/mol")
ax.axhline(0.1,color="grey",ls=":",lw=1); ax.text(2,0.12,"plausible cytoplasmic G1P (~0.1 mM)",fontsize=8,color="grey")
ax.axvline(31,color="red",ls="--",lw=1); ax.text(33,2e-3,"measured NAD+/NADH",rotation=90,fontsize=8,color="red")
ax.set_xscale("log"); ax.set_yscale("log")
ax.set_xlabel("cytoplasmic NAD+/NADH"); ax.set_ylabel("[G1P] needed for equilibrium (mM), at DHAP = 0.37 mM")
ax.set_title("G1P concentration required to reverse AraM in vivo",fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
